dedupe_keys.name: climate bonds certified bonds dataset bonds and loans certified under the climate bonds standard

description: The Certified Bonds Dataset of the Climate Bonds Initiative lists every bond and loan certified under the Climate Bonds Standard. The dataset page read on 2026-09-28 shows 875 entries that can be filtered by certification type (asset or use of proceeds), issuer country and status (discontinued, redeemed, repaid, revoked) and exported, with columns for issuer, certification type, issue date, size in issuance currency and in US dollars, term, country, instrument, sector criteria, approved verifier, verifier report and status; the latest entries include grid and storage bonds from Transpower New Zealand, Powerco and SA Power Networks, a low-carbon transport bond from SNCF, a wind bond from Mercury NZ and loans to Japan's railway construction agency. Coverage is global, across dozens of countries. Access is free with an export button; the site's terms of use were not read, and the site states all rights reserved. Caveats: only certified instruments are listed, some sizes are confidential, and the financed assets are described by sector criteria, not by project location. It supports studies of green finance for grids, railways, buildings and renewables. Related record: data-bndes-hub-de-projetos-concession-ppp-pipeline complements it with a project pipeline.
